description: The Errors half of defk-euu, split out per grilling 2026-10-12. Three-way cut along the call-graph evidence (not the ticket's original two-way cut): Defk.Errors keeps the registry + public facade (codes/explain!/reference/scope, ADR-0006 surface unchanged); extract Defk.Errors.Diagnostics (locate/span/render/compile_error, L1044-1264 - shares only footer/1 with the registry) and Defk.Errors.Rewrites (unsupported/unsupported_local, the call_rejection table, fill/collect_rewrites, L1268-1879). Both hidden. Pure file moves - the six-function consumed interface already exists. Codes stay strings (user-visible currency in docs/explain!/footers) but err! validates the code against the registry at compile time, so a typo fails mix compile. Tests: locate/span units on pathological source; rewrite property (every suggestion parses and uses only kernel-subset forms); compile_rewrites_test stays as e2e net. Generated-docs flow untouched (registry does not move). Can land opportunistically - no dependency on the ctx work.
title: Split Defk.Errors three ways: registry, diagnostics, rewrites (defk-euu part 2)
